Compact budget fields matching the advanced chat settings surface. Callers may relabel the token field when their payload contract uses a different budgeted unit, such as conversation turns.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/ModelSelector.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { BudgetSelector } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
